quick_facts.label: What the job is
quick_facts.value: Human resources managers plan, direct or coordinate the human resources activities and staff of an organisation.

quick_facts.label: Other names for it
quick_facts.value: Job titles O*NET reports for this occupation (Human Resources Managers) include HR Manager, Employee Relations Manager, HR Operations Manager and HR Director.

quick_facts.label: Typical preparation
quick_facts.value: O*NET places this occupation in Job Zone Four (considerable preparation needed): most of these occupations require a four-year bachelor's degree, but some do not.

sections.heading: What a human resources manager does
paragraphs: Human resources managers plan, direct or coordinate the human resources activities and staff of an organisation.

The tasks below are taken from the O*NET profile for Human Resources Managers. O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Act as the link between management and employees by handling questions and interpreting and administering contracts.
Plan, direct and coordinate the work of HR staff.
Advise managers on organisational policy matters.
Represent the organisation at personnel-related hearings and investigations.
